links.outcome: Hallucination rate of RAG responses to identical query across repeated runs and dialogue history lengths
links.effect: Hallucination rate rose from 5% (no history) to 40% with 10 prior exchanges, with the identical query run 100 times per history length.
links.quote: The hallucination rate surged from 5%(no history) to 40% with just 10 prior exchanges, revealing a critical failure mode.
